method: Original Everon05HeavyMetal direct developer harness, copied profiles, --nosound and synchronization validation. Terrain-grounded gate/tower/outer-battlement/corrected-inner-court views, not Steam-route, physically walked route or mission completion. Auto/TAA100%, one bounce, RT sun/cloud shadows, AO/water/volumetrics off. Native-route warm10 then Off/On/On/Off settle4/sample6 at1920x1080 and2560x1440. Three-view baselines plus fresh one-view inner baselines compare against four-view reduced accepted runs; each view resets/warms independently. No build/heavy census/other game during timing.
batchAcceptance: Original broken-stone identity201 and five exact mineral regions563/564/566/567/568. Outer battlement565 withdrawn for a same-runtime raster boundary; not fixed by deferring reception. Whole castle slit/window/gate photographs are not registered. Original apertures, background, grass/soil and dark board finish retain specific source reasons; original lighting/geometry/opacity/capture gates unchanged.
visualLimits: Nine source-unknown images physically viewed among17 decoded references. Mineral approximations are unmeasured and retain photographic pixel shading. Existing foliage/LOD/CPU-native differences are separate; spatial-only MSAA grain is not clean MSAA acceptance. Source prerequisites, scene family footprints and bounded eligible hit identities have different meanings; no all-world percentage or all-placement claim.

buildArtifacts.identityLimit: Public basec7b9fed plus batch23 data/tests before documentation commit. SourceHEAD alone does not identify loaded bytes; shaders, reserved identity range and safety functions unchanged.
